---
name: Feature request
about: Propose new functionality or an enhancement
title: "feat: "
labels: feature
assignees: ''
---

## Background

What's missing or limited today, and why it matters. Link related issues if any exist.

## Scope

What this issue covers — be as concrete as you can (which endpoints/components/pages are affected, what the new behavior looks like).

## Out of scope

Anything adjacent that's deliberately *not* part of this issue (helps avoid scope creep and makes it easier to spin off follow-ups cleanly).

## Acceptance criteria

How we'll know this is done — ideally testable statements, not just "it works."

## Depends on

Any issues this is blocked by, if applicable. Also record each one as a GitHub "blocked by" relationship (see Issue conventions in CLAUDE.md); say here why, and list anything that is not an issue (a person, a device, a decision).
